title: Kenworth C509 Heavy Duty Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar #63
description: Kenworth C509, 5 post Road Train Custom Built FUPS Compliant Bullbar. Heavy duty 381 style reinforced channel with extended heavy duty 100mm wide box uprights to lower cow catcher with 3 mini uprights. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. Tow hitch protector plate, painted to suit chassis colour. LED combination daylight running and indicator repeater lights can be fitted to the outer uprights. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to allow for maximum dimension combinations. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Driving light mounts on upper rail. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty backing plate for additional strength & 38mm tow pin. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirement.
